premises.text: Traffic navigation apps are not as smart as they could be due to pre-computed routes and assumptions about traffic.
premises.evidence_span: the apps you use aren't nearly as smart as you think. Let's say we're going from downtown LA to Santa Monica. Where does that route actually come from? There are literally billions of possible routes, even for that short drive.

premises.text: Current navigation apps rely on outdated traffic data, leading to frequent rerouting.
premises.evidence_span: they assume traffic doesn't change during the course of your drive. This means if you search to go somewhere at 3 p.m., each stretch of road is calculated using traffic data for 3 p.m.

premises.text: More accurate traffic data sources exist, such as loop detectors and traffic cameras.
premises.evidence_span: there are much more accurate sources of traffic data besides phones, like loop detectors and traffic cameras.

premises.text: Telego provides time-dependent routing based on real-time traffic data.
premises.evidence_span: we built the first-ever intelligent routing layer for minute-level data.

premises.text: Businesses that depend on navigation currently face poor options for integrating real-time navigation.
premises.evidence_span: any company that needs navigation is faced with three really poor options.

premises.text: TallyGo's SDK allows companies to easily embed real-time navigation into their existing apps.
premises.evidence_span: With TallyGo's navigation SDK, for the very first time, any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps.

value.text: Businesses can improve efficiency and reduce costs by integrating real-time navigation.
value.evidence_span: they would be printing money, and so would Uber.

notes: Examples of traffic data sources and the demo with the fire department illustrate the capabilities of the SDK.
